title: InspectionOutcome
description: Checkpoints CP8. The first piece of state in the app that is NOT rebuildable -- a human judgement that exists nowhere else and cannot be regenerated by build_snapshot(). Enum frozen 2026-09-05 (eng review), canonical source 04 Prototype/NEXT-STEPS.md item 4. inspection_rank_at_time and risk_score_at_time are captured once at write time and never re-derived -- ranks reshuffle between pulls (see Checkpoints CP1), so precision-at-quota must be computed from these frozen values, not from a live join against scored.parquet.
_outside_voice_corrections: 2026-09-05, same eng review session, cross-model check: three problems the interactive review itself missed. (1) The original design compared 'inside cutoff' inspections against 'outside cutoff' inspections -- but nothing ever recommends inspecting outside the cutoff, so that denominator is structurally empty forever. Fixed by in_control_sample: a real precision-at-quota control group needs a deliberately-sampled comparison set, not an incidental one. (2) inspection_rank spans ALL 79,068 works (rank.py has no completion_status filter) but the 10 percent cutoff is computed over only the 44,810 works under implementation (web/lib/data.ts) -- two different populations. Fixed by freezing cutoff_rank_at_time and population_n_at_time alongside the rank, so 'inside the cutoff' is decidable from the row alone. (3) The enum has six values but precision-at-quota needs a binary 'had an issue' -- seeing _issue_mapping below.
_outside_voice_corrections_round_2: 2026-09-05, same session, second outside-voice pass, three more: (4) work_id 'stability across pulls' (ingest/mplads_adapter.py) was asserted, never observed -- there has been exactly one real pull. If the portal ever re-issues WORK_RECOMMENDATION_DTL_IDs, a stored outcome silently orphans on the next re-pull, and CP8's own rebuild test wouldn't catch it (it reads cached tiles, never re-pulls). Fixed by denormalizing enough context (state, constituency, implementing_agency, work_category, sanctioned_amount_inr) onto the row that an orphaned outcome is still human-readable and hand-rematchable. (5) No inspector identity -- the deck promises 'reviewers train the model' (plural) but nothing recorded which reviewer, making inter-rater disagreement invisible. Fixed by required inspector_id. (6) UNIQUE(work_id, inspected_on) picked 'rejected' when Checkpoints CP8's own wording allows 'rejected or explicitly versioned', and blocked a real case: agency_unresponsive in the morning, a real inspection by a different (or the same) inspector that same afternoon. Fixed in the store layer (not this schema): a surrogate outcome_id primary key, UNIQUE(work_id, inspected_on, inspector_id) so the same inspector double-submitting the same work+date is still rejected, and a nullable supersedes pointer for explicit amendments. outcome_id/supersedes are store/response concepts, not required submission fields -- see nidhinetra_pipeline.outcomes.store.

_issue_mapping._rule: Frozen at the same moment as the enum, never chosen after seeing real results (Checkpoints CP9's own anti-post-hoc-bias rule, applied here to a second free parameter the original CP8 spec left open). true = counts as an issue found. false = counts as no issue. null = inconclusive, excluded from precision-at-quota's denominator entirely, because no inspection of the WORK actually happened.

_f01_context_version: F-01 (nemotronreview.md). The outcome store adds a context_version column. Rows written before the IDA/IA split are context_version 1: their stored implementing_agency value is IDA_NAME, so outcomes/store.py reports it as implementing_district_authority and reports implementing_agency as null when reading them. Stored values are never rewritten. Rows written after the split are context_version 2 and store both fields with their true meaning.

work_id.description: Matches normalized_record.work_id. An outcome for an unknown work_id is rejected by the API, not stored.

inspector_id.description: Free-text initials or name, whoever recorded this outcome. No auth exists in this prototype (main.py has CORS and nothing else) so this is self-reported, not verified -- still required, because the deck's 'reviewers train the model' claim needs to be able to say which reviewer.

state.description: Denormalized from normalized_record.state at write time, purely for orphan-recovery (see _outside_voice_corrections_round_2) -- never the source of truth, and never re-derived from it.

constituency.description: Denormalized from normalized_record.constituency at write time. Same orphan-recovery purpose as state.

implementing_district_authority.description: Denormalized from normalized_record.implementing_district_authority (IDA_NAME) at write time, for orphan recovery like state. Null when the source has none. F-01: see _f01_context_version.

implementing_agency.description: Denormalized from normalized_record.implementing_agency (IA_NAME, the executing agency) at write time. Nullable: many works have no payment event yet, and an outcome must not fabricate an agency. F-01: see _f01_context_version.

work_category.description: Denormalized from normalized_record.work_category at write time. Same orphan-recovery purpose as state.

sanctioned_amount_inr.description: Denormalized from normalized_record.sanctioned_amount_inr at write time. Same orphan-recovery purpose as state.

inspected_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The date the inspection actually happened, not the date it was recorded on screen.

outcome.description: A closed enum of observable facts, never a verdict. 'fraud', 'clean', 'verified' and 'corrupt' are deliberately excluded -- an inspection confirms what was observed, not an accusation or a clearance.

notes.description: Free text, always present (may be empty). The pressure valve for anything the enum doesn't cover, without letting the enum grow to cover every edge case.

inspection_rank_at_time.description: risk_scored_record.inspection_rank at the moment this outcome was recorded, frozen. Never re-derived from the current snapshot -- that is what makes precision-at-quota honest across rebuilds.

risk_score_at_time.description: risk_scored_record.risk_score at the moment this outcome was recorded, frozen alongside inspection_rank_at_time.

cutoff_rank_at_time.description: The 10 percent quota cutoff rank, over works under implementation only, at the moment this outcome was recorded. Frozen alongside inspection_rank_at_time because the two are drawn from different populations (see _outside_voice_corrections) and only comparable if captured together.

population_n_at_time.description: Count of works under implementation at the moment this outcome was recorded -- the population cutoff_rank_at_time's 10 percent was computed over. Without this, cutoff_rank_at_time alone can't be told apart from a rank drawn from the full all-works population.

in_control_sample.description: Assigned by the server (routers/inspections.py _server_control_assignment) and never accepted from the client (F-09): true only when the server pre-assigned this work to a random comparison sample before the inspection. No such registry exists yet (R-05), so every outcome recorded today is false. Rows stored before F-09 may carry an officer-chosen true.
